question: Find the full names of drivers who have competed in at least one race where some constructor scored zero points, and whose average fastest lap time (converted to seconds) across all their races is less than 90 seconds.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers AS d
WHERE d.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT r.XCL_075
    FROM results AS r
    WHERE r.XCL_074 IN (
        SELECT cr.XCL_011
        FROM constructorResults AS cr
        WHERE cr.XCL_013 = 0
    )
)
AND d.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT lt.XCL_044
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY lt.XCL_044
    HAVING AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, 1, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
        + CAST(SUBSTR(lt.XCL_047, INSTR(lt.XCL_047, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
    ) < 90
)

)
